name: spatial-camera-suite
title: Spatial Camera Suite
description: A theme-aware spatial interface stage with eight seekable camera and carrier recipes: the original five shots plus subject tracking, card-to-page morph and gathered lockup.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: Use a scene-relevant shotStyle. `items` is up to three pipe-separated `label::detail` pairs; prefix exactly one featured label with `*`. Original five shots retain their behavior. subject-follow-track keeps a moving featured card framed; container-morph expands that same card into its page; gather-lockup brings the same three cards into one cluster. Supply real project-local imageUrl only for visual evidence. All eight styles use one deterministic timeline and shared camera; do not stack another camera transform.
